features.title: Add the Red Eye tool (J-group)
features.summary: Click a red pupil to neutralize the reflection: a new J-flyout tool and paint.redEye command that corrects a window around the click, keeps catchlights, and errors instead of no-op on a miss.
features.why_selected: Standard portrait-retouch tool, completely missing from the J flyout after Patch and Content-Aware Move landed. Real demand from photo-editing users of a desktop raster editor. Small, click-local kernel (not a novel filter). Does not overlap Remove Background or Relight.
features.dup_check: CLEAN 2026-10-08. Open PRs (~62): no Red Eye / paint.redEye. Issues #213 and #794 are other tools. Merged last week: Patch #381, CAM #814, Magnetic Lasso #864, Remove Background #734, Relight #735. rg RedEye/red-eye empty in crates/. Authored open PRs: 0.

features.title: Add the Pattern Stamp tool (S-group)
features.summary: Paint with the current Patterns-panel tile: a new S-flyout sibling of Clone Stamp and paint.patternStamp, with Aligned and Impressionist, reusing compose pattern tiling and the retouch stroke path.
features.why_selected: Standard painting tool; the S flyout is currently Clone Stamp alone. Pattern fill already exists, but brush stamping does not. Fits one PR by reusing Tile/Placement/render and run_stroke. Does not overlap round-1 commands.
features.dup_check: CLEAN 2026-10-08. Open PRs: no Pattern Stamp / paint.patternStamp. No issue. Fill-with-pattern and pattern fill layers are different commands. rg PatternStamp/pattern stamp empty. Authored open PRs: 0.
